script.spokenHook: The crypto market slipped today, yet Solana somehow managed to stay green.
segmentLines: Solana gained nearly 2% to trade near $123 while the broader market stumbled.
It sits right in the middle of its 24-hour range with an RSI of 59.
This move comes as CoinDesk reports Solana's fast settlement upgrade reached a second test network.
script.takeaway: Green for now, but stuck in the middle
